name: genesis-automation-test
description: Manual local QA console for GenesisApp semantic cases and device automation.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n service,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @genesis/qa-service" "npm run dev -w @genesis/qa-web"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n service,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start -w @genesis/qa-service" "npm run start -w @genesis/qa-web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @genesis/qa-core && npm run build -w @genesis/qa-service && npm run build -w @genesis/qa-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @genesis/qa-core && npm run typecheck -w @genesis/qa-service && npm run typecheck -w @genesis/qa-web && npm run typecheck -w @genesis/qa-appium
